svg.aria-label: A diagram titled The rule that never mentioned Lightning. Two columns. Left, the six tests in FinCEN's 2023 definition of crypto mixing: pooling funds from many people; code that coordinates a transaction's structure; splitting a payment across independent transactions; single-use wallets and addresses; swapping between types of digital asset; user-initiated delays. Right, where ordinary Lightning plumbing touches each test, in the author's reading: a service provider's liquidity serving many users; batched channel opens and splicing; multi-path payments; one-time invoices; swaps into other assets, only if used; and no close match for delays. A footer notes that the word Lightning appears zero times in the 2023 proposal and zero times in the 2026 withdrawal, and that the right-hand column is the author's reading, not FinCEN's. A timeline strip reads: proposed October 23, 2023; withdrawn October 6, 2026.
